steps.say: Words rhyme when they sound the same at the end.
Say them aloud. Cat and hat both end with at.
Poems often have rhyming words at the end of lines.
Some poem words sound like the noise they name.

hints: Listen for un at the end.
check.explanation: Sun and fun rhyme. They both end with un.

options.why: Sit ends with a different sound.
Sad ends with a different sound.
